param: μ_H Natural mortality rate of human population
μ_M Natural mortality rate of mosquito population
v Vaccination rate for susceptible humans
ω_V Waning immunity rate for vaccinated humans
p Waning immunity rate for recovered humans (loss of natural immunity)
η_S Transmission rate from infectious mosquitoes to susceptible humans (vector-borne)
ξ_S Transmission rate from infectious humans to susceptible humans (non-vector)
β_M Transmission rate from infectious humans to susceptible mosquitoes
a₂ Progression rate from vector-exposed (E_H1) to infectious
γ Progression rate from non-vector-exposed (E_H2) to infectious
n Rate of seeking treatment for infectious humans
δ_T Recovery rate for treated humans
a₃ Progression rate for exposed mosquitoes to become infectious
